educators.title: Coach Eugene
educators.children: is a graduate student in Nutritional Science working toward becoming a Registered Dietitian. His approach to nutrition is evidence-based and culturally rooted. He believes there isn't just one path toward your goals, so his coaching keeps helpful structure while staying flexible enough to fit your life. While Coach Eugene is building a strong foundation in clinical nutrition, his true passion is sports nutrition, and he hopes to serve immigrant communities by creating healthier, still-delicious versions of the cultural foods they love. Outside of school, you'll find him gaming, cooking, or giving haircuts to friends and family. Pull up and chat with him!

educators.title: Coach Fátima
educators.children: is a Nutrition and Dietetics Technician, Registered, who firmly believes that we are all capable of creating a life in which we live well and reach our goals by adopting positive lifestyle habits. Coach Fátima has experience as a dining server, clinical nutrition assistant, and nutrition educator, and aspires to build a career in community dietetics and diabetes prevention. She is eager to empower her community to support care for the mind, body, and planet. When she is not studying, she enjoys reading, crocheting, and trying new foods. Ready to talk? Let’s grow!

educators.title: Coach Aurora
educators.children: is a graduate student in Nutritional Science and a future Registered Dietitian. She believes that food is fun and never something to fear. Coach Aurora is interested in community nutrition, especially working with her Spanish speaking community to prevent chronic diseases through food education. She has been a chef for almost 15 years and she knows a thing or two about stretching your food dollar and creating flavorful foods, even on a budget. She believes that everyone deserves access to affordable food and volunteers weekly volunteer at her local food pantry.

educators.title: Coach Yazmin
educators.children: is a graduate student in Nutritional Science and a future Registered Dietitian. She is passionate about creating a welcoming space where you will feel comfortable sharing your relationship with food while maintaining autonomy and setting realistic and achievable goals. Coach Yazmin is especially interested in community nutrition and hopes to help underserved communities make healthy eating more affordable, accessible, and sustainable. As an avid animal lover, Coach Yazmin believes our furry friends can make our movement more enjoyable and motivating. When she’s not learning about nutrition or staying active, you can find her grabbing a matcha or a meal at Chipotle.

educators.title: Coach Nicole
educators.children: is a graduate student in Nutritional Science who believes that nutrition should be inclusive and centered around enjoying the foods you love. She is passionate about helping patients one-on-one as a Future Registered Dietitian Nutritionist, especially within Hispanic and Latino communities. Coach Nicole believes that healthy eating should never mean giving up your favorite foods, but learning how to create balance. Outside of nutrition, she enjoys staying active, roller skating, and baking something sweet in the kitchen.

educators.title: Coach Kevin
educators.children: is a Nutritional Science graduate student who loves sports and is working towards becoming a Registered Dietitian Nutritionist. With the skills he has learned throughout his educational journey, Coach Kevin is ready to help you meet your health and nutrition objectives. If you’re looking for someone to help you spice up your eating habits, then look no further and make an appointment today.

educators.title: Coach Sela
educators.children: is a culinary arts graduate, a Nutritional Science graduate student, and a future Registered Dietitian. Her goals are to empower you to live a healthier life without giving up the cultural foods you love. She believes nutrition should support your heritage and happiness because all foods are inclusive. Coach Sela enjoys foods from all around the world, especially Mexican food with a side of Agua fresca.  As a bilingual coach, fluent in English and Spanish, Coach Sela will create a safe and inclusive space for you to explore. She approaches sessions with kindness, a helping hand, and a warm smile. She ensures that you feel seen, heard, understood, and encouraged on your wellness journey. When you are ready, let's take the next step together.

educators.title: Coach Steven
educators.children: is a Nutritional Science graduate student on a path to becoming a Registered Dietitian, and brings over a decade of experience working in a hospital environment with a focus in pharmacy, as well as having served in the U.S. military. Coach Steven is passionate about helping you find balance between developing a healthier relationship with food and working towards a beneficial, active lifestyle. Coach Steven believes nutrition should be personalized to your unique goals, lifestyle, and circumstances rather than based on a one-size-fits-all approach. His goal is to create a supportive, judgment-free environment where you can feel heard, empowered, and confident in making positive changes.

educators.title: Coach Kendra
educators.children: is a graduate student in Nutritional Science with a background in patient care and clinical administration. She is passionate about making nutrition education accessible, believing that learning about food and wellness should feel engaging, not intimidating. She looks beyond the numbers on a chart to understand how nutrition fits into your everyday life, creating a space where you can feel safe, heard, and supported without judgment as you work toward your goals. Outside of nutrition, Coach Kendra has a background in music and enjoys designing educational apps and games, blending creativity with science in her approach to wellness.

faq.question: Who can use Recreation?
faq.answer: Recreation is open to all Cal State LA students, staff, and faculty. What you can access depends on the kind of student you are — the membership page has the breakdown.

faq.question: Where is everything?
faq.answer: Recreation 1 and Recreation 2 are on the basement level of the U-SU. The Game Room is on the first floor in room 104. The Wellness Zone is in South Village Housing.

faq.question: How do I sign up for a workout class?
faq.answer: Through the Recreation portal at recreation.calstatelausu.org, or the free Cal State LA Recreation app on the App Store and Google Play.

faq.question: What is in the Game Room?
faq.answer: 8-ball pool, air hockey, foosball, and ping-pong, plus Nintendo Switch favorites including Super Smash Bros., Mario Party, and Mario Kart.

faq.question: Is there nutrition support?
faq.answer: Yes. Golden Eagle Nutrition Education (GENE) offers free personalized coaching with Nutritional Science graduate students.

rules.title: Closed-toe athletic shoes
rules.description: Non-marking soles in every activity area. No sandals, cleats, socks, or hard soles — group fitness and special classes excepted.

rules.title: Athletic attire, no denim
rules.description: A shirt or top at all times in public areas. Denim is not permitted in any fitness activity area.

rules.title: Check in at the Front Desk
rules.description: Every visit, for activity spaces and locker rooms alike. Guests need a staff member to authorize access each time.

rules.title: Sealed, non-glass drinks
rules.description: Food is not permitted in activity areas, and beverages have to be in a sealed, non-glass container.

rules.title: Headphones on, cameras off
rules.description: No devices in the locker rooms or restrooms, and no recording anyone. Music through headphones, never a speaker.

rules.title: Park your wheels outside
rules.description: Bikes, scooters, skateboards, and hoverboards go in the designated racks. ADA assistance devices are always welcome.
